source: MG 2026-11-12 (KNOWN-BUGS C4, C9): goal coins/stars and prize wheels from the fanbyte FR_Minigame pages' Goals rows (alt Coins/Stars icons in the raw HTML) and Prize Wheel Rewards lists. Item ids by client NameId text (item-table.json, inventory.json definitions); gendered rows keep their GenderUsage so a wheel shows each wearer only what they can wear. Goals pay on a win, each goal met; the wheel lands on one slot per win, uniform (R). Rows marked (R) borrow the nearest analogue where the page leaves a value blank.
